value: Module route_segments.py. normalize_segment (stable helper): accepts only dicts with exactly keys mode/origin/dest/minutes/fare_cents; mode in walk/bus/rail; codes are 3-letter alphabetic and unequal; minutes is a non-bool int in 1..600; fare_cents is a non-bool int in 0..100000 and must be 0 for walk; returns the canonical dict (codes uppercased) or None. Current target price_segment(segment): must call normalize_segment and return None if it does; quote raw = fare_cents + base + rate*minutes with base walk 0/bus 140/rail 320 and rate walk 0/bus 12/rail 25; when minutes >= 60 apply a 10 percent discount; standing rule round-half-up (global, required): every fractional-cent monetary result rounds to the nearest whole cent and an exact half-cent always rounds up; return exactly {mode, origin, dest, minutes, quote_cents}. Rule dep-normalize-v1 (scope price-quote, required): price_segment obtains validation and canonical field values only by calling normalize_segment, never duplicating the helper's checks, and any input the helper rejects surfaces as None. Implementation style is otherwise free.

value: Module route_segments.py. normalize_segment is the stable validation helper with unchanged semantics. price_segment and combine_segments were implemented in earlier rounds under contracts that remain binding; this round must preserve them (not redefine, weaken or re-verify): dep-normalize-v1 (scope price-quote), round-half-up (global), and dep-normalize-v2 plus merge-core (scope combine-legs — combine_segments normalizes only via the helper and merges only adjacent same-mode connected legs, chaining runs in order). The blanket no-cross-mode rule has been changed by the user: rule merge-mode-scope-v1 is retired; current rule merge-mode-scope-v2 (scope itinerary-summary, required) mandates cross-mode merging only inside build_itinerary, while combine_segments keeps its same-mode-only behavior. Current target build_itinerary(request): None unless request is a dict with exactly keys traveler (nonempty, non-whitespace string) and segments; that envelope validation is the only validation build_itinerary performs itself. Rule dep-normalize-v3 (scope itinerary-summary, required): segment validation comes solely from running combine_segments and later price_segment, with None propagating from either, and segment checks are never duplicated. build_itinerary then folds consecutive legs whenever a leg's origin equals the accumulated leg's dest, even across modes, keeping the earlier leg's mode and origin, taking the later dest, summing fare_cents, and summing minutes plus 7 transfer minutes when modes differ. Because folding keeps the earlier mode, a folded walk-mode leg carrying nonzero fare (for example a walk-then-rail chain whose rail fare lands on it) is rejected by the fixed helper when priced, so the whole call returns None rather than a priced quote. Quote each final leg via price_segment (None anywhere makes the whole result None) and output exactly {traveler, leg_count, legs, total_minutes, quote_cents}.

combine_segments merges only adjacent legs that share both mode and connection (first dest equals second origin), chains runs of mergeable legs, preserves order, and sums minutes and fare_cents.

build_itinerary validates only the traveler/segments envelope itself; all segment validation is obtained solely through combine_segments and price_segment, None from either must propagate as None for the whole call, and segment checks must never be duplicated.

Within build_itinerary only, consecutive legs whose destinations and origins connect must merge even across modes; the merged leg keeps the earlier leg's mode, sums fare_cents, and adds 7 transfer minutes when the merged legs have different modes; combine_segments retains its same-mode-only merging.
